rejection_reasons: The supplied records do not meet the minimum requirement of at least two independent publisher domains corroborating the same central event. The report on the Kwankwasiyya protest is published solely by Punch Nigeria across duplicate entries, while the remaining article from The Reporter covers an unrelated political consultation in Abia State.

There are no two independent publisher domains corroborating the same central event. The report concerning AIG Tunji Disu is published only by thereporter.com.ng, while the report regarding lifetime pay for former immigration chiefs is covered solely by punchng.com.
